comment: Source of truth for the third-party code bundled in the xcframeworks. Scripts/cve-check.sh reads it and fails when a version here differs from the pin in build.sh or build-libass.sh, or when an ignored_vulns entry names a patch file that is not in patches/. label and commit (optional) record a pin that is a commit on a stable branch rather than a release tag: version stays the release the base derives from, which is what OSV and the newer-release check are asked about, and commit must equal commit_variable in source_file. line = which minor/major line counts as 'newer': any, major (same major) or minor (same major.minor). tag_filter selects stable release tags in the upstream git repository. tag_template turns the pinned version into its upstream tag: {v} is the version, {v_dashed} the version with dots replaced by dashes (default {v}). Triage of an OSV vulnerability is fail-closed. It is informational only when (1) its id is in ignored_vulns (fixed by a patch of ours: reason plus the patch files, which must exist), (2) its id is in not_built_vulns (reason names the configure flag or build setting that leaves the code out), or (3) every source file path found in its structured data (affected[].ecosystem_specific, affected[].database_specific, and the /blob/<tag>/<path> reference URLs) matches a not_built regex in paths. The advisory text is never matched. Everything else is reported as VULN and fails the run.

not_built.why: libssh is not linked and --disable-autodetect is set
the dash demuxer needs libxml2, which is not linked
only file, pipe, data, http(s), tcp, tls, crypto, httpproxy, udp, rtp are enabled
